app.message: Service app is updated with Recreate because it mounts volume appvol (ReadWriteOnce)
Bind source /srv/app/data must exist on every node that may run app
tmpfs /cache of service app counts against its memory limit
Kubernetes does not copy the image's files into an empty volume mounted at /app/sub (Docker does)
app.hint: Seed the volume from the entrypoint, or mount a subdirectory the image does not ship.
